clusters.mechanism_claim: A release-critical semantic object/action remains safe only when producer, artifact/state/receipt identity, epoch/generation, intended consumer/use and authority are verified at consumption rather than merely recorded upstream.
clusters.prediction: Cross-boundary substitution/splice/stale-state faults fail closed before consequential use when consume-bound verification is present.
clusters.falsifier: Branch-local guards match or beat a common consume-bound contract on the integrated fault matrix with lower complexity/cost.
clusters.highest_risk_confound: Shared project ancestry creates pseudo-replication across Frank branches.

clusters.mechanism_claim: Reward projection must be a deterministic derived state bound to an authoritative stable source frontier/snapshot; duplicate-safe folding alone does not establish currentness under concurrent terminal commits.
clusters.prediction: Concurrent DONE commits are either included in the captured frontier or force explicit PREFIX/STALE classification; restart reproduces the exact same projection for that frontier.
clusters.falsifier: A machine-enforced topology proving no concurrent terminal writer can coexist with a fold makes separate frontier identity redundant.

clusters.mechanism_claim: Model-latent state is a distinct evidence plane; useful runtime control requires causal/selective intervention and held-out value, not decodability alone, and non-identifiable representations remain equivalence hypotheses.
clusters.prediction: Some latent probes will decode strongly yet fail selective causal control or transfer; only a subset will improve outcome/control beyond existing system receipts and LoopDynamicsReadout.
clusters.falsifier: Across matched OOD and perturbation tests, simple system receipts/behavioral readouts match all incremental predictive/control value at lower cost.
clusters.highest_risk_confound: Probe learns task format/input artifacts or intervention changes off-target properties.

clusters.mechanism_claim: A model-native workspace-like latent substrate and explicit ClayGWT may be complementary, redundant, antagonistic or model-specific and must not be collapsed by analogy.
clusters.prediction: Native-workspace x ClayGWT factorial produces non-additive or separable effects on complex reasoning, receiver-use/re-entry, recurrence/diversity or resource cost if they are functionally distinct.
clusters.falsifier: Lesion/steer of putative native workspace has no incremental causal value once ClayGWT and simpler model-output controls are fixed, or effects are fully redundant.
clusters.highest_risk_confound: Measurement method defines the workspace it claims to discover.

clusters.mechanism_claim: Owner-fixed identity, contextual persona, fast appraisal and slow regulatory personality/reward state should remain separate timescale/authority constructs.
clusters.prediction: Factorized persistent state improves longitudinal warranted adaptation and restart/OOD consistency without allowing psychometric/persona outputs to define identity.
clusters.falsifier: Prompt-only persona matches factorized state on longitudinal outcomes, stability and recovery at materially lower complexity.
clusters.highest_risk_confound: Human psychometric labels may not map to stable machine mechanisms.

clusters.mechanism_claim: Compilation, quantization or model-build changes can change activation geometry enough that latent probes/steering must be revalidated before control authority transfers.
clusters.prediction: At least some probes/steering directions change calibration, selectivity or efficacy across exact model/build/quantization identities.
clusters.falsifier: Pre/post build probes remain invariant within declared tolerance across matched held-out/OOD interventions and resource budgets.
clusters.highest_risk_confound: Behavioral task accuracy may remain stable while latent geometry changes, or vice versa.

clusters.mechanism_claim: Recurrence should be task-conditioned by unresolved pressure and marginal verified outcome gain rather than treated as universally beneficial.
clusters.prediction: Adaptive recurrence beats fixed/event-only baselines on a subset of complex/OOD tasks while remaining bounded on automatic tasks.
clusters.falsifier: Fixed/event-driven control matches quality/calibration at lower latency/resource/instability cost.
clusters.highest_risk_confound: More compute can masquerade as a better recurrence mechanism.

clusters.mechanism_claim: Higher-order alternative sets are useful only where pairwise/simple projections lose decision-relevant information or preserve false certainty.
clusters.prediction: Hyperposition improves transfer/calibration or prevents false mechanistic collapse on non-identifiable/higher-order cases after cost matching.
clusters.falsifier: Pairwise/factorized simpler representation preserves the same decisions and uncertainty at lower cost.
clusters.highest_risk_confound: Representational complexity mistaken for new causal information.

clusters.mechanism_claim: Frank WAL persistence must bind exact SQLite source/build/topology; known vulnerable lines cannot be accepted merely by package/version labels.
clusters.prediction: Known-fixed source or machine-proven unreachable vulnerable topology survives the WAL-reset discriminator; vulnerable exact source does not.
clusters.falsifier: Exact target build is independently proven patched/backported or topology proof eliminates all documented trigger conditions.
clusters.highest_risk_confound: Package version string does not prove loaded library source or backport state.

anti_echo: Equivalent wording across Clay/Frank/GWT/UnifiedDB/ClayGraph is shared ancestry unless independently executed or externally supported.
